messages:
Sarah (Sales): Heads-up — SummitPay POC is converting to pilot and asks for a bespoke tiered commit. They want Dedicated + Private and requested 35% off year 1. Asking for quick decision, timeline ~June onboarding. Deal doc: https://redwood-deals.internal/SUM-112
Alex M: Can you confirm the commit numbers and term? 35% on dedicated is pretty aggressive.
Sarah (Sales): Opportunity details: 12mo commit, gross list $120,000. 35% -> net $78,000. They plan ~80% utilization on dedicated pool. POC metrics attached in the doc.
Vince Eng: FYI dedicated + private control plane adds non-trivial infra and ops delta. Ballpark infra delta ~ $15k/mo for the pool + network egress considerations. Need to validate with infra team.
Priya (CS): Customer wants pilot -> prod by June. They have ~10 internal apps to onboard. We estimate CS + integration ~80 hrs to get to GA.
Maya - Legal: Bespoke pricing requires an amendment and legal review. Also need security questionnaire and KMS/export checks for private deployment. Recommend conditional approval only after secQ and SOW are finalized.
Alex M: @Maya what's the expected legal turnaround if we expedite? Also Emily — finance, can we tolerate a 35% concession here?
Maya - Legal: With expedited review ~3 weeks (draft amendment + review). If we stick to standard T&Cs we can approve more quickly.
Emily (Finance): Quick P&L: 35% on $120k with $15k/mo infra and 80hrs CS puts gross margin below our floor. We can approve up to 30% only with extended commit (>=18mo) or other protections. For 12mo, our limit without exec sign-off is 28% if they prepay or meet usage floors.
Sarah (Sales): SummitPay can prepay for 12mo. They prefer 12mo though, not 18. They said security sign-off is doable within 2-3 weeks.
Dealbot: Deal desk request created: DD-4821 — SummitPay bespoke pricing request (28% requested as counter).
Alex M: I'm willing to approve 28% conditional on: 1) Security questionnaire completed and signed off, 2) 12mo prepay or upfront invoice, 3) SOW includes capacity addendum and acceptance criteria. @Maya please prepare amendment language.
Maya - Legal: Will draft amendment and KMS/SLAs. Setting expectation: 3 weeks for final contract if we get secQ back this week.
Priya (CS): I'll own onboarding plan and allocate CS lead. I'll also capture the 80hr estimate in the SOW.
Sarah (Sales): Great — I'm going to offer 28% conditional on the items above and push for prepay. I'll update the opportunity and notify SummitPay.
Alex M: Conditional approval granted :thumbsup:. Keep me posted on secQ and prepay confirmation.
Sarah (Sales): Thanks — closing thread for now. Will post contract update once countersigned.
thread_summary: Sales thread requesting bespoke commit discount for SummitPay POC -> 12mo $120k commit; discussion on infra/CS/legal impacts; finance limits 28% for 12mo prepaid; conditional approval given pending security questionnaire, prepay, and SOW amendment.
